notice: This document is an analytical closeout for Campaign 3 Phase 2 (P2). It does NOT freeze, select, or recommend any values for M, R, k, B, B_max, T_solution, or T_mutation. RFC-1 v3 remains in DRAFT state and open items P3-P18 remain blocked.

axis_A_search_starting_baseline.SHARED: 8k solution calls per block, shared across both guided and unguided arms.
axis_A_search_starting_baseline.SEPARATE: 16k solution calls per block, matched set of 8k guided and 8k unguided.

axis_B_mutation_lineage_topology.BLOCK_SHARED: 2M mutation generation calls per block (M guided, M unguided shared across replicates).
axis_B_mutation_lineage_topology.REPLICATE_SPECIFIC: 2kM mutation generation calls per block (M guided, M unguided per replicate).

call_classes_and_accounting_semantics.subject_model_solution_calls: Solution generation calls to the subject model under evaluation.
call_classes_and_accounting_semantics.mutation_generation_calls: Calls to the mutation generator LLM to synthesize mutant instructions.
call_classes_and_accounting_semantics.local_evaluator_executions: Grading runs on the local benchmark harness (zero provider tokens).
call_classes_and_accounting_semantics.transport_attempts: Total transport attempts = R * logical_calls, where R >= 1 is a mandatory symbolic integer multiplier.
call_classes_and_accounting_semantics.token_accounting_notes: Pre-response and zero-body retries contribute zero output tokens to the body but may incur provider-dependent input token metering or billing exposure.

24kB.derivation: Covers confirmatory evaluation tasks only: 3 arms (Baseline, Guided, Unguided) x 8 confirmatory tasks x k replicates = 24k calls per block; total 24kB. Completely omits search starting baselines, mutant search evaluations, secondary holdout evaluations, and mutation generation calls.

(98k + 6)B.derivation: Assumes M = 3, SHARED search starting baseline (8k), and BLOCK_SHARED mutation topology (2M = 6). Solution calls = (8k [search base] + 16(3)k [search mutants] + 24k [confirmatory] + 18k [holdout]) = 98k. Mutation generation calls = 2(3) = 6. Total provider logical calls per block = 98k + 6; total over B blocks = (98k + 6)B.

(106k + 6)B.derivation: Assumes M = 3, SEPARATE search starting baselines (16k), and BLOCK_SHARED mutation topology (2M = 6). Solution calls = (16k [search base] + 16(3)k [search mutants] + 24k [confirmatory] + 18k [holdout]) = 106k. Mutation generation calls = 2(3) = 6. Total provider logical calls per block = 106k + 6; total over B blocks = (106k + 6)B.

p2_reference_algorithm.derivation: Corresponds to SEPARATE search baselines (16k) and REPLICATE_SPECIFIC mutation topology (2kM). Solution / evaluator calls per block = (16 + 16M + 24 + 18)k = (58 + 16M)k. Mutation generation calls per block = 2kM. Total provider logical calls per block = (58 + 18M)k; total over B blocks = (58 + 18M)kB. When M = 3, this evaluates to (58 + 54)kB = 112kB.

prior_figure_reconciliation.conclusion: None of the prior figures is authoritative because neither the search baseline axis nor the mutation topology axis nor M nor (k, B) has been frozen by the operator.
